# rom-weaver

> A local-first browser tool for applying and creating ROM patches. Files are processed on-device without uploads or accounts.

## Web app

- [Apply ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/weave): Apply patches with format detection, checksum validation, and ordered patch chains.
- [Create ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/create): Create patches with format-aware settings and distributable bundles.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/README.md): Choose the guide for using, integrating, deploying, or developing rom-weaver.
- [CLI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/cli.md): Installation, commands, supported formats, compression, checksums, trimming, and JSON output.
- [Web app integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/webapp-integration.md): Preloaded URLs and same-origin OPFS integration.
- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/self-hosting.md): Docker, static hosting, reverse proxies, subpaths, HTTPS, and browser isolation headers.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Crate graph, registries, browser workers, OPFS, and the Rust-TypeScript boundary.
- [Release guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/.github/RELEASING.md): Release automation, publishing channels, and retry procedures.
